violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: glass cleaned in chlorine sanitizer glass dish machine in the bar area concentration reading 0ppm at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: EHS instructed CFM to discontinue using chlorine sanitizer glass dish machine and to transferred dirty glasses to HT dish machine in the main kitchen. RUTH'S CHRIS STEAK HOUSE (Inspection Date: 07/01/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: roasted red peppers 47F and shredded cheddar cheese (67F) stored in improper ice bath (not enough ice around TCS food products) on prep counter at the end of prep line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated roasted red bell pepper and shredded cheddar cheese to walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F or below. CFM added more ice to ice bath to surround TCS food items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Trauslen 1 Dr UR refrigerator (47F) end of prepline, Trauslen 2 Dr preptop puddling water bottom of unit under Salad King cooler (side prep area).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS instructed CFM to store TCS food items in unit with refrigeration of 41F or below and schedule maintenance on unit. EHS instructed CFM to schedule repair for unit and relocate plates (used for service).

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device (Y splitter) on the water supply system.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: Ecolab technician was onsite and changed out Y splitter to pressure bleeding backflow prevention device during inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: water puddling at the bottom of the Trauslen 1 dr reach in cooler in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS instructed CFM to schedule service on reach in cooler.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. EHS instructed CFM to obtain heat sensitive test strips or high temperature thermometer to test the internal temperature of the high temperature dish machine in the kitchen area to ensure it reaches a minimum of 160F surface temperature.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bin is not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.
